description: A candlelit vigil with inertial windbreaks and moving flower offerings.
name: Funeral Ritual V2 · Difficulty 1 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Uncover the memorial, light its single candle, and protect the flame against changing drafts for thirty seconds. There are no flower offerings in this vigil. Move the windbreak across the draft; its ribbon shows the current crossing and the next two seconds. The shield follows your input directly. A lost flame ends this episode. Say farewell after the vigil. Solve only from screenshots and visible task controls. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or hidden-state access. Use only the task tab and its visible controls.
